description: This file defines a React component called DataTable that renders a customizable, paginated, sortable table with sticky headers and optional server-side data fetching. It includes internal functions for measuring text width, handling sorting, pagination, and rendering table rows with loading states and actions.

methods.name: measureTextWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of a given text string using an off-screen canvas for accurate auto-width calculation, with a fallback to character count if canvas is unavailable.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a nested value from a data object based on a dot-separated path string.

methods.name: setPageAndNotify
methods.description: Sets the current page, triggers data fetch if in server mode, and scrolls the table body to top.

methods.name: toggleSort
methods.description: Handles sorting logic when a column header is clicked, toggling sort direction or resetting to default, and fetching data in server mode.

methods.name: onBodyScroll
methods.description: Adds or removes a CSS class to the header to indicate scroll state for visual effects.

methods.name: PaginationControls
methods.description: A React component that renders pagination buttons and controls for navigating pages.
